TUTORIAL // HOW TO PLAY

ESC in any room opens the menu — restart the room, pick another one, or go back to the main menu.

MOUSELook / aim
W A S DWalk · double-tap W / S / A / D to dodge: dive-roll forward, back, left, right (costs stamina)
SHIFTSprint (stamina) · vaults low walls and boxes (or climbs onto long ones) · you can shoot on the run (but not while aiming)
SPACEJump · from a sprint it's a hands-first dive · hold to reach for ledges
C (hold)Crouch · SHIFT+C = slide (slide into someone to kick them; slide over pickups to grab them)
C at low coverFacing a low wall or box (or sliding into one): take cover — you stay down until you press C again or walk away · hold right mouse to rise and shoot, let go to duck
LMBFire the selected weapon
RMB (hold)Aim: the view zooms, shots are tighter, you walk instead of running
MMBFire a rocket from the wrist launcher, whatever is in your hands (the standard one holds one rocket and recharges by itself)
WHEEL / Q · 1 2 3 41 pistol · 2 launcher · 3 shotgun · 4 rifle — shotguns, rifles and the big 3-rocket launcher lie around the arena; a fighter who dies drops the one in their hands
EKick — knocks fighters down, sends boxes and spiders flying · at a magenta gravity panel the arena turns 90°
TWave — offer an alliance. Someone who stands in front of you and presses T too accepts you in their team.
R / ESCReload / pause

Rockets (middle mouse, or slot 2): slow, then accelerating. A direct hit kills outright, and the blast hurts anyone near it — aim at the floor or a wall beside your target. Fighters in the air take little damage but get thrown hard.

Kick a gravity (magenta) panel on the outer walls and the whole hall turns so that wall becomes the floor.

Alliances: press T to wave. A fighter who comes to stand in front of you and presses T too bows with you, and you take their color: from then on you're a team until the round ends. Bots stop targeting you (friendly fire still hurts — a teamkill costs a frag), the team's score is its members' frags averaged, and if the team wins you all win. Bots offer and accept alliances too, and like to gang up on whoever is winning. There must always be two sides: the last lone fighter can't be absorbed.

GAMEPAD (Options → Controls → Gamepad)
LEFT STICKMove · click it to sprint
RIGHT STICKLook / aim · click it to dodge · aim assist (Options menu)
LTFire the selected weapon (left click)
RBAim (right click)
RTFire a rocket (middle click)
A · X · BJump · kick · crouch (B while sprinting = slide)
D-PAD UPWave — offer / accept an alliance
Y · LBNext weapon · reload
STARTPause · in menus A - select, B - back
